rule: Two levels: the shelf, then the graphic. Each entry's question, answer and evidence date are copied from the graphic's own data file at build time and are not a second home for any fact. Controlling track (Katie, 2026-10-20, DR-105): the vault focused pages built from the masters are the front door; Codex's Reading Specimens views are suggestions until rebuilt in the vault kit.

rooms.name: Crypto & Digital Money

rooms.name: Education Policy & Research Funding
rooms.holds: University funding and controls, research security reviews, and state education policy.

rooms.name: Citizenship, Voting & Immigration

rooms.name: Sanctions, Oil & the Military

graphics.question: When a shop "accepts stablecoins," what does the shop actually receive?
graphics.answer: A shop can accept a customer's stablecoin payment and still receive ordinary money. The saved Stripe product credits the merchant in USD, while Shopify defaults to its normal payout currency and lets eligible merchants claim USDC instead. Stablecoin-funded cards also pay shops through ordinary card settlement. Separately, some processors offer stablecoin settlement after shoppers pay normally. The saved records mix live products, limited offerings, pilots and infrastructure; they do not show how most shops are paid.
